Hymn 127: Does the Journey Seem Long?
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: Joseph J. Daynes
Lyricist/Text Author: Joseph Fielding Smith
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 127 titled "Does the Journey Seem Long?" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by Joseph Fielding Smith.
